Name: Content Patcher Animations - Leyline Paths
Author: PeaslyWellbott
Description:
Replaces the Crystal Path with a low-key animated rainbow effect. I like using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2277]Faster Paths[/url] with pathing outside the Farm, but wanted something that wouldn't interfere as much with the other maps' aesthetics.
